findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: data_quality_issues, edgar_as_of_financials, edgar_companies_sec_correspondence, system_ingestion_status · Private data: replay_verify, account_checkout_link, edgar_as_of_financials, edgar_companies_filings_earnings_release, edgar_companies_sec_correspondence, identity_search, query_replay, query_verify_snapshot · Public sink: account_checkout_link, edgar_as_of_financials, edgar_companies_sec_correspondence, metrics_segments · Destructive: replay_verify, edgar_as_of_financials, edgar_companies_statements_restatement_timeline, edgar_statements_restatements_ledger, query_execute.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: data_quality_issues, edgar_as_of_financials, edgar_companies_sec_correspondence, system_ingestion_status · Private data: replay_verify, account_checkout_link, edgar_as_of_financials, edgar_companies_filings_earnings_release, edgar_companies_sec_correspondence, identity_search, query_replay, query_verify_snapshot · Public sink: account_checkout_link, edgar_as_of_financials, edgar_companies_sec_correspondence, metrics_segments · Destructive: replay_verify, edgar_as_of_financials, edgar_companies_statements_restatement_timeline, edgar_statements_restatements_ledger, query_execute

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
